name: LegionWareX
summary: A medieval high-fantasy adventure sandbox built around Bloom Level-Up: dragons, monsters, magic, knights and Fresh Animations, with Better Combat. Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).
_comment: FreshOrangeSlices' LegionWareX (2026-10-26), from the Medieval High Fantasy master list and goals docs: a sandbox full of optional content, no required ending, dangerous but not miserable, multiplayer first. Combat route: Better Combat (not Epic Fight); Better Mob Combat is left out (its last build crashes the server on Mowzie's Mobs). Magic: Iron's Spells, plus the RPG Series' Paladins & Priests and Rogues & Warriors (no Wizards, Elemental Wizards or Archers). No voice chat (friends should be able to join with nothing extra). Mods are in cumulative layers so CI can tell which layer breaks what; the shipped pack is every layer. Forge 47.4.28 (1.20.1's recommended; Iron's Spells and others need 47.4+). Modrinth projects by slug (newest 1.20.1 Forge release or beta; required dependencies are added automatically, and the few a mod needs without saying so on Modrinth, such as Iron's Lib, are listed next to it; Migamigos' Framework is CurseForge-only, so it's packed inside). Bloom and the CurseForge-only mods ('external') are packed inside, which is fine for sharing with friends but not for publishing.

layers.name: core
layers._comment: Bloom with Better Combat and the Fresh Animations set (the earlier Forge pack), plus the performance mods, since they change how everything renders.

layers.name: creatures
layers._comment: Creatures, bosses and companions, with the spawn and structure control that keeps them memorable instead of everywhere.

layers.name: magic-and-gear
layers._comment: Iron's Spells as the mage, the RPG Series' Paladins & Priests and Rogues & Warriors (Spell Engine comes with them), weapons and armor, and the recipe glue for all of it. Marium's Soulslike Weaponry is on test (power creep).

layers.name: animation-and-qol
layers._comment: The rest of the visual stack (Punchy! stays unless testing shows it fights Better Combat), and the quality-of-life and multiplayer mods.

client_presets._resource_packs: Bottom to top, above vanilla's Default (and Forge's mod resources). Bloom switches them on before the game first reads options.txt, once per change of this list (client/mixin/OptionsMixin).

files._comment: Client config files, as given (the mod fills in every setting left out). Ice and Fire replaces Minecraft's title screen with its own book menu; FreshOrangeSlices wants Minecraft's own.
